exposure: middle cerebral artery pulsatility index multiples of the median (MoM)
vertebral artery pulsatility index multiples of the median (MoM)
umbilical arteries pulsatility index multiples of the median (MoM)
outcome: Postpartum admission to neonatal or pediatric intensive care units
cohort: 2140 fetuses attending the day hospital unit of a tertiary referral hospital, of which 182 entered into spontaneous or induced labor and were delivered within 24 h of examination
finding: In a high-risk population of third-trimester fetuses delivering within 24 h of examination, middle cerebral artery pulsatility index multiples of the median was the best predictor of adverse perinatal outcome.
